origins.section: Every Heuristic Plan Is Reported Against the Best Bound Known
A Rolling Horizon Plans a Few Years at a Time and Keeps Only the First Ones
A Neighborhood Must Free Projects That Compete for the Same Money and Crews

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-gap: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-gap: "Its quality is the gap between its value and the best upper bound known ... or a MIP search stopped early, whose best bound is the tightest of the three here." Here that bound is 81,900, and (81,900 - 81,200) / 81,200 = 0.86%.
recorded.prompt:q-end-effect: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-end-effect: "The loss has a name, the end effect: a window that ends in year b sees nothing beyond it, so it spends money and crews on projects that start inside it, even when the same money would earn more on a project whose best start comes later."
recorded.prompt:q-neighborhood: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-neighborhood: Freeing three years frees every project competing for those years' budgets and crews at once, including the end-effect mistakes the rolling horizon made, so moving one project's start can make room for another's.

recorded.prompt:q-gap:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap:b: The gap is taken against "the best upper bound known". In the page's example the stopped MIP's bound is tighter than the LP's ("LP relaxation bound 220,238.3" vs "bound 219,722").
recorded.prompt:q-gap:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap:c: "A heuristic returns a plan, never a proof. Its quality is the gap between its value and the best upper bound known". The gap is never measured against the plan itself.
recorded.prompt:q-gap:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap:d: Gaps are reported before any proof: "its reported gap of 0.07% was honest and, as gaps against a bound are, pessimistic". The page also says "A planner who had stopped at 'the heuristic's plan' without a bound would have had no way to tell these two apart."
recorded.prompt:q-end-effect:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-end-effect:a: Node count does not set plan quality: "The window-4 plan, after 5,909 nodes of search ... is worth 216,672; the monolithic solver had 219,411 after 200 nodes."
recorded.prompt:q-end-effect:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-end-effect:c: Every rolling plan "breaks nothing", and "Every plan breaks no rule (capital.violations checks each one in plain Python)."
recorded.prompt:q-end-effect:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-end-effect:d: "Budget and crew rows stay in for every year". Every window's plan "breaks nothing".
recorded.prompt:q-neighborhood:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-neighborhood:a: fixes every other project to the current plan, and solves the MIP that is left, here to optimality — each step already reaches its optimum, and the page puts the cause in the neighborhood: "there is almost nothing to rearrange"
recorded.prompt:q-neighborhood:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-neighborhood:b: Two kinds of neighborhood, eight steps each, both starting from the window-4 plan — the region run already started from the rolling-horizon plan and gained $37k
recorded.prompt:q-neighborhood:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
